title: Fix retry attempt accounting and backoff
instruction: Fix retry(operation, options) in src/retry.mjs. options = { attempts, baseDelayMs, sleep }. attempts is the total number of calls including the first and must be a positive integer (else RangeError). Before retry number k (k = 1, 2, ...) await sleep(baseDelayMs * 2 ** (k - 1)). No sleep happens after the final failed attempt. operation receives the 1-based attempt number. On final failure throw an AggregateError whose errors array contains every thrown error in order. Resolve with the first successful result.
